payload.contentHtml:
@levelsio
Even bigger irony of getting rich is that everything expensive isn't that much better than when you paid normal for it

Many things are even worse (most expensive luxury hotels are guaranteed worse than regular simple hotels, I know I tried most of them now)

The real reason you wanna get rich is not to buy expensive things

It's so that $1M invested gives you 3% to take out every year with no risk, which is $30,000/year

Which you can use to travel for $1000/mo on a shoestring budget forever without having to back to some desk job with a shitty boss

Aka FREEDOM
@levelsio

The irony is that traveling on <$1000/mo is way more fun than >$10,000/mo Luxury travel is extremely boring, comfortable, not challenging, sycophantic (yes sir) Travel on a shoestring budget you get inventive, are forced to meet locals just to survive and get around, have to x.com/splinter0n/sta…

热门回复

@Nairebis - e/max-acc ♥ 70 · 💬 1

Flying first class is objectively WAY better than flying coach. Agree about luxury hotels in terms of luxury (boring), but one nice thing is that more money buys you closer to the better/more interesting part of the city (e.g., NYC).

@@levelsio ♥ 63 · 💬 3

Dude you chose to have a kid right? You expected it to be free or something?

@@levelsio ♥ 63 · 💬 1

Agreed I only fly business

@@levelsio ♥ 44 · 💬 3

No because I did to get free

I was never interested in luxury cars and all that bs

@Tanning Salon Don ♥ 48 · 💬 1

Bro what?

Expensive hotels are way better.

The people actually take pride in their work and act like they care about your experience
